Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A small British utility room: a white oak worktop runs along one wall; under the worktop on the left stands a plain white front-loading washing machine with a round glass door; on the right, clearly different, stands a plain white tumble dryer with a solid white round door with no glass window and a slim water container drawer at the top left of its front panel. Sage green shaker cupboards above, a folded stack of cream towels and a woven basket on the worktop, a small window with daylight. Nothing on top of the appliances except the worktop.
